events.message: The file's internal index was damaged — this is what Word reports as a corrupt document — so the content was read directly from inside it.
Found and read 9 sections of the file this way.
Checking the document body for damage…
Done. The rebuilt file is ready to download.

report.summary: Recovered what could be read and rebuilt it as a valid Word file. This is a best-effort recovery, not a complete repair.
recovered: read your content out of a file whose internal index was damaged — the damage Word refuses to open
kept 4 headings, 5 paragraphs and 1 picture, with their structure intact
carried 1 picture back into the document, where it was
lost: footnotes, headers and footers could not be put back into their original places, so their text is set down at the end of the document under its own heading
